english translation text: The night of the bereaved, the night of the bereaved

arabic text: Maqtal me gunjti rahi, Zainab ki ye fughaan\nShaame Ghareebaan, Shaame Ghareebaan
english translation text: This lament of Zainab continued to echo through the battlefield\nThe night of the bereaved, the night of the bereaved

arabic text:
Mehmaan bulaakar hame barbaad kiya hai
Had hogayi ek bundh bhi paani na diya hai
Rota raha hai pyaas se, Asgher sa be zubaan
Shaame Ghareebaan, Shaame Ghareebaan
english translation text:
You invited us as guests and then destroyed us
You exceeded every limit—not even a drop of water was given
An innocent infant like Asghar kept crying from thirst
The night of the bereaved, the night of the bereaved

arabic text:
Jo ghar se gayaa, waapas nahi aaya
Paamaal huwa dasht me, Shabbir ka laasha
Ab tu hi bataade mera, Abbas hai kahaan
Shaame Ghareebaan, Shaame Ghareebaan
english translation text:
Whoever left the tents never returned
Shabbir's body was trampled in the desert
Now tell me—where is my Abbas?
The night of the bereaved, the night of the bereaved

arabic text:
Tu aai aise waqt me, jab chin gai rida
Khaimoke saath nanha sa jhoola bhi jal gaya
Phela huwa hai chaaro taraf dekhle dhuaan
Shaame Ghareebaan, Shaame Ghareebaan
english translation text:
You came at a time when our veils had been snatched away
Along with the tents, the little cradle was also burned
Look—smoke has spread in every direction
The night of the bereaved, the night of the bereaved

arabic text:
Ghash me para hai Aabide bimaar kya karun
Koi nahi hai mera madadgaar kya karun
Akber shaheed hogaye, ab kown de azaan
Shaame Ghareebaan, Shaame Ghareebaan
english translation text:
The ailing Abid lies unconscious—what can I do?
I have no helper left—what can I do?
Akbar has been martyred; who will now call the adhan?
The night of the bereaved, the night of the bereaved

arabic text:
Aai thi karbala me bharaa ghar liye huwe
Abbas mere sar pe the saaye kiye huwe
Mei aaj tanhaa rehgai, aadaa ke darmiyaan
Shaame Ghareebaan, Shaame Ghareebaan
english translation text:
I came to Karbala with a household full of loved ones
Abbas stood above me like a sheltering shade
Today I have been left alone among the enemies
The night of the bereaved, the night of the bereaved

arabic text:
Jaana hai qaid hoke jo zindaane shaam me
Roro ke din guzaarungi yaade imam me
Baandhi gai hain dekhiye shaanome rassiyaan
Shaame Ghareebaan, Shaame Ghareebaan
english translation text:
We must now go as captives to the prison of Shaam
I will spend my days weeping in remembrance of the Imam
Look—the ropes have been tied around our shoulders
The night of the bereaved, the night of the bereaved

arabic text: Majboor be watan hun nawaasi nabi ki hun\nZehra ki laadli hun me beti Ali ki hun\nKyun resmaan me baandhi gai, hai qalaaiyaan
english translation text: I am helpless and far from home, yet I am the Prophet's granddaughter\nI am Zahra's beloved and Ali's daughter\nWhy have my wrists been bound with ropes?

arabic text: "Rehan" daastaane umam, kaise ho raqam\nZainab ke bayn likh nahi sakta mera qalam\nChashme qalam se khun ke aansu huwe rawaan
english translation text: "Rehan", how can the story of this nation be written?\nMy pen cannot record the laments of Zainab\nFrom the eye of the pen, tears of blood began to flow
